The game follows the story of a young man who, after experiencing hallucinations, seeks psychiatric help and undergoes hypnosis with time gems. He is then transported to the village of Stone Dragon and becomes the new village chief. The village is under attack from demons, and the player must save and rebuild the village.

Game Storyline:

Stone Dragon is a small village that has been invaded by demons, and it is up to the player to save the village and build it back up. The player is reincarnated as the new village chief after saving the old village chief. The player will have to employ various animals such as snails, ants, and wild boars to dig for treasure in the abandoned mine. The player will also have to forge and refine medicine and learn ancient spells to save the village.

After resolving the village crisis, the totem monument's energy will surge, indicating the village's prosperity. The player can trade with gnomes, engage in stock trading, and build a courier station. However, the player will soon realize that everything is not as it seems, and he will have to venture into the dungeon maze. The maze is filled with trolls, evil spirits, demons, and monsters, and the player must navigate through it to survive.

The player can also collect design drawings to forge equipment and various items and build a home by repairing and upgrading buildings. After defeating demons, the player can acquire pets, and the player can inherit and match attributes on the rune tablet. The game also features interesting side quests and mini-games.

Gameplay Experience:

Dragon and Warrior offers an interesting other world and plot design, and players can experience different races with unique skins and characteristics. The player can employ all kinds of animals for logging and mining, collect design drawings to forge equipment and various items, and build a home by repairing and upgrading buildings. The player can also get pets by hunting demons after defeating them and inherit and match attributes on the rune tablet.

The game features a maze dungeon adventure, full map free memory transmission, and stations for trade and finance to develop the economy. There are also some strange and interesting small games and Easter eggs.
